project.description: Exact name of an existing vault project, or empty string if none fits

suggestedNewProject.description: If no existing project fits, a short folder-style name for the topic or client. Otherwise empty.

confidence.description: 0 to 1: how sure you are about the project

reason.description: One sentence explaining the project choice

confidential.description: True for line-management 1-2-1s, HR, pay, performance or personal matters about a named colleague

title.description: Clear meeting title in sentence case, under 60 characters

subject.description: What the meeting is about, 1 to 4 words, naming the client and workstream

gist.description: One sentence, under 20 words: the main outcome for the user

summary.description: Markdown bullet list, 3 to 6 bullets, plain British English

goals.description: 1 to 4 outcomes the meeting is working towards. Group every action under one.

why.description: One short sentence on why it matters

stated.description: True if the meeting explicitly set this goal; false if you inferred it

headline.description: 3 to 7 words, starts with a verb, names the specific thing and the client or workstream so it makes sense out of context

text.description: One sentence, specific enough to act on without the meeting

owner.description: Full name of the person responsible if explicit; empty if unclear

attribution.description: me ONLY if the notes explicitly give it to the user; other if they explicitly name someone else; otherwise unassigned

stated.description: True if agreed in the meeting; false if it is your suggestion

due.description: YYYY-MM-DD deadline if one was stated or clearly implied, else empty

dueStated.description: True if the deadline came from the meeting

time.description: HH:MM 24h only if a specific time was stated, else empty

people.description: People who took part or own actions, excluding the user. Full names where known.
